title: Adversarial NLI: A New Benchmark for Natural Language Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on hypothesis-only baselines to see if they predict labels without the premise, and testing on NLI stress tests to measure reliance on statistical heuristics like word overlap, length, negation, and spelling errors.

Creating an exclusive test subset containing examples from human annotators who were never included in the training data to verify that models are not merely overfitting to the specific writing styles or artifacts of individual workers.
